annotations.title: What drives compulsory (chova) insurance pricing / משתני ביטוח החובה

description:
Use when the person asks what their compulsory insurance (ביטוח חובה) price depends on: which of the regulator's pricing variables come from the car and what the ministry data says for this car (by plate) or for each trim of a model-year (make + model + optional year), plus the driver variables. With no arguments: the variables themselves and why they matter. Returns NO prices: prices are in the official regulator calculator (car.cma.gov.il), which is linked.
אילו משתנים קובעים את מחיר ביטוח החובה לרכב הזה, בלי מחירים. המחירים במחשבון של רשות שוק ההון.

make.description: Make in Hebrew, English or slug, e.g. "קיה", "Kia", "kia". / יצרן.

model.description: Model in Hebrew, English or slug, e.g. "פיקנטו", "Picanto", "picanto". / דגם.

plate.description: Israeli licence plate, 7 or 8 digits; dashes/spaces allowed (e.g. "12-345-67"). / מספר רישוי.
